summary: Reviewed the Astro home visual pass and ran the available locked tests. Vitest passed all 86 tests across deck, i18n, and token suites; no frontend browser run was possible because Astro requires Node >=22.12.0 while this container provides Node 20.20.2.
action_items: Run Astro check, build, and Playwright home/chrome suites in a Node >=22.12.0 environment.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical issues found in the reviewed home route, motion, token, or global style files. Locked deck logic was unchanged.

success_rate.frontend: 100% unit/locked suites; browser coverage not run

context_for_next_testing_agent: Vitest command is `yarn --ignore-engines test`; adding --runInBand fails because Vitest does not support that Jest flag. Astro commands fail before startup on Node 20.20.2.
test_credentials: Not applicable; no auth flow tested.
rca of the issue: Validation environment mismatch: package.json declares engines.node >=22.12.0, but the container has Node 20.20.2. This prevents Astro check/build/dev and therefore prevents browser testing; it does not indicate an application failure.
